name: Mom
source:
Slava's mother, his only close person and part-time head of the family, on which the whole life is based.

A sensual but practical woman of a bourgeois mindset, who had been worried about her son's well-being all her life. As much as possible, he tries to insulate Slava from any problems, worries and, in principle, events that go beyond emotional balance. 

She broke up with her husband more than 18 years ago and has been "raising" her son alone ever since. In a certain sense, it depends on Slava no less than he depends on her.

She works as a pharmacist in a pharmacy. He spends most of his free time watching TV shows or meeting with other single friends. She has many different useful acquaintances — the merit of her close communication with the family of her brother Boldejor.

She's honest, and she's used to working hard to achieve every little thing.
